name: 089 — A word means one thing II
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for the whole of feature 089, the character sheet's thirteen rows, under one command: man:dealable() is the count and sp:available() keeps the predicate, skill():buyable() is a collection, credo:questsDone() is a count and not a Quest, :level() is gone from all three receivers, slot means the action bar, the three distinguished members are identity comparisons, buff:remaining/slot:hold/craft:recipe/condition:tooltip say their unit and their source, a boolean is a bare adjective, and s:craft() IS the open recipe. Every retired spelling is asked to raise and to name its replacement.
